name: EvoSynth-Bench: Multi-Algorithm Hyperparameter Optimization Trajectories & Pathological Landscapes Benchmark
description: A standardized benchmark dataset comprising 120 multi-algorithm hyperparameter optimization (HPO) trajectories (GA, PSO, DE, CMA-ES) across XGBoost, LightGBM, and Random Forest, paired with a 2,000-sample pathological non-convex classification landscape designed with 30% asymmetric label noise to stress-test meta-optimizer exploration and escape mechanisms.

affiliation.name: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

creator.name: Group G002 - Automated Machine Learning & Optimization Lab

distribution.name: Pathological Classification Benchmark (2000 samples, 20 features, 30% noise)
Full HPO Optimization Trajectories across 4 metaheuristic algorithms
